meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: Claude 会先对比你改过的代码和上游新版,生成一份记录改动内容和意图的迁移指南;升级时先取上游干净版本,再按指南重新应用你的自定义改动,而不是直接合并代码。
howto.when: 当你说要升级 NanoClaw 或迁移自定义改动,且本地代码与上游有分叉时触发;它会先检查工作区是否干净,再评估改动规模并开始提取,已有指南时会询问是否直接升级。

say.text: 帮我把对这个 NanoClaw 的修改生成迁移指南。
say.note: 它会扫描改动,并问你要先描述还是自动分析。

say.text: 升级到上游最新版,保留我的自定义配置。
say.note: 它会先提取改动,再在干净副本上重新应用。

say.text: 把已有的迁移指南更新一下。
say.note: 它会对比新提交,把新改动补进指南。

howto.what_en: Claude extracts your customizations from a forked NanoClaw, writes a replayable migration guide (intent + implementation detail), then upgrades by checking out clean upstream and re-applying changes from the guide instead of merging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to migrate/upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork. It checks the working tree, assesses scope, extracts customizations, and offers to skip to upgrade if a guide already exists.

say_en.text: Generate a migration guide for my customizations to this NanoClaw fork.
say_en.note: Scans changes; asks you to describe or auto-analyze.

say_en.text: Upgrade to the latest upstream while keeping my custom config.
say_en.note: Extracts changes, then reapplies them on a clean checkout.

say_en.text: Update the existing migration guide with my new changes.
say_en.note: Diffs new commits and appends them to the guide.
